title: C-CAL-1/2/DQ/ROOT through the full Host/registry chain (make_services -> generated registry -> ProcessHost.invoke)

c_cal_dq.expected: NaN + DQ flag + named Issue; NaN raw with valid DQ -> invalid_model and no Native

c_cal_root.expected: same shared-root set across calls, no per-call random root

fixed_configuration.chain: make_services -> open_command -> RegistryBuilder -> generated::register_builtin_types -> generated::register_processes -> freeze -> make_host -> invoke<CalibrateInput,Ref<NativeObservation>> -> wait_external
fixed_configuration.usage_work: process usage aggregates stages; per-sample consume_work(1) is a lower bound
fixed_configuration.commands: one fresh command per scenario (cal12 / dq / root); see README finding about a 5th operation in one command

tolerance: exact double equality for the fixed dyadic inputs; interval must enclose the exact value; DQ/Issue and Codes by name
